title: ChatGPT SaaS Product Demo Ad

shots.layout: full-bleed pastel gradient (purple/blue/peach), floating white card
shots.motion: card fades/scales in, text types into card
shots.highlight: single white card centred on gradient, checkmark appears
shots.notes: frames 0-49: model-picker card mock, no real UI chrome

shots.layout: full-bleed white, centred pill search input, tagline bottom-centre
shots.motion: typewriter into input, tagline colour word swaps (deeper -> faster)
shots.text: Our smartest, fastest model yet | Think deeper / Think faster
shots.highlight: typing caret in input, coloured keyword in tagline
shots.notes: frames 49-172: keyword color changes purple -> red -> orange on each swap

shots.layout: full-bleed light blue gradient, stacked file chips (pdf/xlsx/doc)
shots.motion: chips slide in vertically, 'Analyzing...' subtitle typing

shots.layout: full-bleed white, large left-aligned body text, then warm gradient end card with pill button
shots.motion: text typewriter/streams in, zoom-in on paragraph (text grows to exceed frame), then cut to end card, button text types
shots.text: Go-to-market (sales_deck.pdf): The current sales deck positions... | Available now ->
shots.highlight: zoom on streaming response text; CTA pill
shots.notes: frames 215-330; typed CTA 'Available n' -> 'Available now' with arrow

style.layout: no device mockup; flat full-bleed compositions, single UI element (card, input pill, file chips, text block) centred on plain or gradient background
style.background: alternates soft multi-stop pastel gradients (purple #8E7CC3, blue #7FA7E8, peach #F1A07A, cream #F6E7C8) and pure white #FFFFFF
style.typography: sans-serif (Inter/SF-like), regular weight, sentence case; tagline bottom-centre with one coloured keyword; body text large left-aligned
style.camera_motion: mostly static; slow push-in on streaming text in shot 4 (frames ~250-290)
style.transitions: hard cuts between scenes; elements fade/scale within scene
style.ui_highlight: isolation (one element on empty canvas), colour keyword, checkmark reveal, zoom on generated text
style.text_animation: typewriter/streaming characters, word swap with colour change
style.pacing_frames: shots 49 / 123 / 43 / 115, avg 83; micro-beats every ~14 frames inside shots
style.real_ui_vs_motion: motion-designed recreation of ChatGPT UI, no real screen recording
style.three_beat: yes: input typed (start) -> files analysing (action) -> answer streams + CTA (result)

verdict: Ultra-minimal motion-design ad: one UI element per scene on white or pastel gradient, never a full app screenshot (sheet_1 frames 0-172).
Story told via typewriter text and streaming responses, no cursor (sheet_1, sheet_2).
Hard cuts only, 4 shots in 330 frames, average 83 frames; feels calm because each shot holds 1.5-4 s.
Highlight = isolation + colour keyword + push-in on result text (frames 250-290), not boxes or spotlights.
Ends on a gradient CTA card with typed pill button (frames ~300-330).

evidence.method: ffmpeg select=gt(scene,0.3) + contact sheets fps=1/step tile 4x3 + visual inspection
